newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 5.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- China sets rules for listed firms on disclosure of transactions with related parties.
- Number of new stock investors declines in Beijing following official efforts to cool nation's stock markets.
- Vice Minister of Machine-building Industry Lu Fuyuan says China's 20 main automakers should re-group to form three to four big companies by the year 2000.
- China sets up internet information centre.
- Survey finds that 78.4 percent of Chinese consumers have been victims of some form of commercial fraud.
- China to host world meat conference in Beijing in September 23-25.
- China plans natural rubber output of 430,000 tonnes and synthetic rubber of 620,000 tonnes in 1997.
- Central Military Commission calls on army to study thoughts of late Deng Xiaoping.
